parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute.

parameters.name: EniId
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary ENI. By default, all secondary ENIs that are attached to the specified instance are queried.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the secondary ENI is attached.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The interval at which to retrieve monitoring data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
- 60.
- 600.
- 3600.

Default value: 60.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute.
